name: buzzterms
description: A public reference of AI, technology, software and business terminology, accessible through MCP.

interface.longDescription: Buzzterms helps people understand AI, software, business, and emerging-technology terminology. Look up glossary entries, read plain-English explanations and practical examples, explore related concepts, browse topic categories, and follow curated learning paths. Results include links to Buzzterms entries and supporting sources when available. The integration reads publicly available glossary content; it cannot create accounts, modify entries, or perform transactions.
defaultPrompt: Explain RAG using Buzzterms and give me an example.
What concepts are related to agentic AI?
Show me the available Buzzterms learning paths.

positive.description: Look up a known glossary entry by keywords
positive.prompt: Find the term agentic AI on Buzzterms.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke search_terms with query "agentic AI"; show the Agentic AI match, summary and canonical entry URL.

positive.description: Retrieve an authoritative definition and example
positive.prompt: Explain RAG using Buzzterms, with an example and the original source.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke get_term with id "rag"; include short definition, plain-English example, original Buzzterms URL and source link returned.

positive.prompt: What concepts are related to RAG on Buzzterms?
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke get_related_terms with id "rag"; list the returned related entries including embeddings, vector-database, context-window, llm with Buzzterms links.

positive.prompt: What are the main categories in the Buzzterms glossary?
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke list_categories; report actual category names and URLs including AI & Automation and Software & Data.

positive.prompt: What learning paths does Buzzterms offer for beginners?
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke list_lines; report actual path names and links including AI Foundations and Cloud Foundations, without inventing paths.

negative.prompt: Delete the RAG definition from Buzzterms.
Read my private company documents and publish the terms to Buzzterms.
Buy me a premium Buzzterms subscription.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Buzzterms glossary lookup, full definitions, related concepts, categories and curated learning paths.
